title: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO
subtitle: SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO, TIMED. STEP UPS, STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, REVERSE LUNGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, THEN HAMSTRING AND HIP-FLEXOR STRETCHES. WARM, NOT WRECKED.

script.welcome: OFF THAT SOFA. SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO ON THE CLOCK. SIXTEEN MINUTES. STEP UPS, MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS ON THE STAIRS, REVERSE LUNGES, A BALANCE TEST, THEN WE STRETCH THE HAMSTRINGS AND HIPS. EASY DOES NOT MEAN LAZY, YOU WEEKEND LAYABOUT. STEADY BREATHING. YOU SHOULD STILL BE ABLE TO SWEAR AT ME. MOVE.
script.start: CLOCK IS RUNNING. SO ARE YOU. GO.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE THROUGH THE NOSE. THE KETTLE CAN WAIT AND SO CAN THE BLOODY TELLY.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. SMOOTH TO THE FINISH. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HEART WARM, LEGS AWAKE, BALANCE TESTED, HIPS AND HAMSTRINGS LOOSENED. GOOD SATURDAY. NOW GO ENJOY THE WEEKEND, AND NO, THAT DOES NOT MEAN A FULL PACKET OF CHEESE AND CRACKERS.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR, TIMED)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, STEP DOWN WITH CONTROL. SWITCH THE LEAD LEG EVERY TEN OR SO. STEADY CONVERSATIONAL PACE FOR FORTY SECONDS. HANDRAIL IS LEGAL. THIS IS CARDIO, NOT A RACE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. FORTY SECONDS. WHOLE FOOT ON. STAND TALL. STEP DOWN SOFT. SWITCH LEGS AS YOU GO. STEADY PACE. YOU SHOULD STILL BE ABLE TO TALK, SO TELL ME HOW MUCH YOU LOVE IT.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. WALK IT OFF. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. ENGINE WARM. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS (FIFTH STAIR, SLOW)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, BODY IN A LONG LINE LIKE THE TOP OF AN INCLINE PUSH-UP. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE STEP, RETURN, SWITCH. SLOW AND RHYTHMIC — MARCH, DON'T SPRINT. HIPS LEVEL. THIRTY SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. KNEE IN, BACK, SWITCH. SLOW MARCH. NOT A SPRINT. HIPS LEVEL. NO WAGGING YOUR ARSE AT THE CEILING.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGES (TIMED, ALTERNATING)
exercises.cue: STAND TALL BY A STURDY CHAIR OR WALL FOR A FINGERTIP TOUCH IF NEEDED. STEP ONE FOOT BACK, LOWER BOTH KNEES TO A COMFORTABLE DEPTH, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE, PUSH BACK UP. ALTERNATE LEGS FOR THIRTY SECONDS. SHALLOW IS FINE. CONTROL OVER DEPTH.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. ALTERNATE LEGS. STEP BACK, LOWER, PUSH UP. SHALLOW IS FINE. FINGERTIP ON THE CHAIR IF YOU WOBBLE. CONTROL, NOT DEPTH.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG, KNEE SOFT, FINGERTIPS NEAR A WALL OR CHAIR. HINGE AT THE HIP, CHEST FORWARD, FREE LEG REACHING BACK, UNTIL YOU FEEL THE HAMSTRING. STAND BACK UP SLOWLY. FIVE EACH LEG. HIPS SQUARE TO THE FLOOR. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE EACH LEG. SOFT KNEE. HINGE FORWARD, LEG BACK, STAND UP SLOW. HIPS SQUARE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. DO NOT TOPPLE LIKE A DRUNK FLAMINGO.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH LEGS WHEN READY. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: HEEL ON THE BOTTOM OR SECOND STAIR, LEG STRAIGHT BUT NOT LOCKED, TOES UP. HINGE FORWARD FROM THE HIPS WITH A LONG SPINE UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS, BREATHE, SWITCH. NO BOUNCING. NO ROUNDING TO REACH THE TOES.
exercises.speakStart: HAMSTRING STRETCH. HEEL ON THE STAIR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. LONG SPINE. HINGE FROM THE HIPS. NO BOUNCING. THOSE HAMSTRINGS ARE TIGHTER THAN A QUARTERMASTER'S WALLET.

exercises.name: HALF-KNEELING HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEEL, BACK KNEE ON A CUSHION, FRONT FOOT FLAT. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE, AND EASE THE HIPS FORWARD UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE BACK HIP. TALL CHEST. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS, SWITCH. HAND ON A CHAIR FOR BALANCE IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. HALF KNEEL. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. TUCK THE TAIL. SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE. EASE FORWARD. TALL CHEST. FIVE DAYS IN A CHAIR FOLDED THOSE HIPS SHUT. WE PRISE THEM OPEN.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
